replies.author: AndrewJKim
replies.body:
Yeah, but in a plugin, if this were to happen, as a Dev, I would think Ivy would make it so:
Everytime 1 tick (1/20 of a second), it checks their inv to see if they have lets say gold block, and then multiply the gold block with 9 and then give that much gold ingots. This CAN lag servers, as it is very fast. It's alot faster than blinking, but if there is another way, he can probably do this, but I don't really see a point in doing this. :L
